test_title: PYST 39: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘FARM’ is coded as HDTP and ‘EGGS’ is coded as GJIV. How will ‘FOOD’ be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Alternately (2) and (3) are added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• ‘FARM’ is coded as HDTP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b9ce45dfbbac37ebc07a12542a9a9a9cbcb2951ffeeac0e059fd2ce4d30db53.png] 

And,

 
• ‘EGGS’ is coded as GJIV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed4e854834b68d6496bfb586ac3b78687e0b0bc52afa7088b1d8d7b1d230971c.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘FOOD’ is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6302a671a0c6c716889645835c2da24bd814c703e303c50c88c2ee0e02225769.png] 

​Hence, the correct answer is "**HRQG**".
